newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka blue-chip banks up on profit expectation.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka blue-chip banks up on profit expectation.

text.p: Two blue-chip Sri Lankan financial stocks rose in early Tuesday trade on investor optimism about their results for the period to June, brokers said.
National Development Bank Ltd was up 1.4 percent or four rupees at 280 and Commercial Bank Ltd voting shares were 2.2 percent or five rupees up at 235.
"With both institutions expected to turn in good profits for the six months to June, buyers do not want to wait until results come out in a couple of weeks," said a local broker.
National Development Bank is one of two development finance institutions listed in Colombo. Commercial Bank is one of four private banks trading on the stock exchange.
